The main takeaway from our work is that

the cost invested in maintaining the logging and mobility information before failure is not necessarily wasted, but can be recouped by the improved failure recovery time that is made possible by the availability of the logging information for failure recovery.
the failure recovery time can be reduced by increasing the logging frequency, the checkpoint interval, the number of checkpoints, or the number of mobile hosts.
